top_story.headline: Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar discloses a wide sell-off of tech and industrial stocks
top_story.dek: A single House filing lists dozens of partial sales dated September 24 across retirement and brokerage accounts.
paragraphs: Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar (R-FL27) filed a Periodic Transaction Report on 10/07/2026 listing roughly 50 transactions in a UBS IRA and brokerage account. Most are partial sales of $1,001 - $15,000 dated 09/24/2026, including Microsoft Corporation, Meta Platforms, Inc., UnitedHealth Group Incorporated, Boeing Company and Space Exploration Technologies Corp.; one full sale of Cisco Systems, Inc. was $15,001 - $50,000.

The filing also shows purchases on 09/02, 09/04, 09/08 and 09/22/2026 of Chevron Corporation, Snowflake Inc. (one $15,001 - $50,000), Okta, Inc., Corning Incorporated and Meta Platforms, Inc. The disclosed ranges are broad, and the filing does not state a reason for the trades.

sections.headline: No new OGE ethics filings flagged in reporting window
paragraphs: No divestiture certifications, termination notices, or other notable ethics filings were identified in the October 5–8 reporting window. Routine annual and periodic disclosures continue across federal agencies.

sections.headline: Salazar's large trade report leads a light filing day
paragraphs: Two House Periodic Transaction Reports, one Senate Periodic Transaction Report, one Senate Candidate Report and five House Candidate Reports were new since the last edition; all PTRs were read in full (well under the 30-filing cap). House Periodic Transaction Reports from Lloyd Doggett and Vince Fong were already covered in an earlier edition.

items: Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar (R-FL27) filed a Periodic Transaction Report on 10/07/2026 listing dozens of stock trades in a UBS IRA and brokerage account, most of them partial sales dated 09/24/2026. Filing. Table below.
Rep. Josh Gottheimer (D-NJ05) filed a Periodic Transaction Report on 10/07/2026 covering two sales in a joint Morgan Stanley account. Filing.

items: Sen. John Fetterman (D-PA) filed a Periodic Transaction Report on 10/07/2026 listing two purchases of a Dell International LLC/EMC Corporation corporate bond (5.6%, matures 2033-09-15), by a child, on 09/15/2026 and 09/16/2026, each $1,001 - $15,000. Bonds, no tradeable stock. Filing.

Jade Simmons, Texas Senate candidate (candidacy commenced 08/17/2026), filed a Candidate Report on 10/08/2026. It reports $250,000 in self-employment income from Jade Media Global, LLC (Kingwood, TX), no reportable assets, and liabilities of a deferred $50,001 - $100,000 federal education loan from the U.S. Department of Education plus two Chase Bank revolving charge accounts ($10,001 - $15,000 and $15,001 - $50,000). Filing.

sections.headline: 16 new lobbying registrations among a quarterly-report surge
paragraphs: The Senate lobbying database returned 200 filings posted since 10/07/2026 (the database reports 695 matching filings, but the API served only the first 200 across its pages, so this is partial): 16 new registrations and the rest mostly third-quarter activity reports and terminations. Third-quarter reports came heavily from Holland & Knight LLP, Squire Patton Boggs and Cassidy & Associates, Inc. New registrations are below; the quarterly reports are routine, nothing notable. A separate automated check found one third-quarter report mentioning pardon-office contacts, covered in the Pardon Lobbying section.
